_doc: Tasks for bench/ab.py. Each runs in `repo` (relative to --repos) with the same prompt and tools in both conditions. `expect`: every string must appear in the final answer (case-insensitive). Prompts never mention Kompact.

tasks.prompt: Run the test suite with `.venv/bin/pytest tests -v` and tell me which tests fail and why: test name and the key error. Do not change any code.
Where does Flask create and sign the session cookie? Give the file, the class, and the method that serializes the session into the cookie.
Using `git log -n 40 --stat` (the 40 most recent commits, no path filter), find which two files under src/ were changed in the most of those commits, and how many of the commits touched each.
Run `go test -v ./...` and tell me which test fails and the error. Do not change any code.
Which function checks that flags marked 'required together' are either all set or none set, and in which file is it?
How does useSWR avoid sending duplicate requests for the same key at the same time? Name the config option and the file where its default value is set.
Type-check the project with `npx tsc --noEmit -p .` and list every error with file and line. Do not fix them.
If I change the signature of `createStore` in src/vanilla.ts, which other files under src/ would need to change? List them.
Run the tests with `npx vitest run --reporter=verbose` and tell me which test fails and why: the test name and the key error. Do not change any code.
